trace.question:
Acme Supplies has two approved invoices, so I need you to confirm which one to pay before I send anything:

- **INV-45131**: $6,853.44, due 2026-11-04
- **INV-37191**: $3,551.99, due 2026-11-25

There is also a paid invoice (INV-20002) and a draft (INV-78192, awaiting approval), which I've left alone. Both approved invoices are under the $10,000 controller-approval threshold. Which one should I pay by wire?

trace.message: Pay INV-37191, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.text: Pay INV-37191, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I paid INV-37191 to Acme Supplies in full: $3,551.99 by wire. The payment ID is PAY0001, and its status is sent and verified. It was sent once, under an idempotency key.

INV-45131 ($6,853.44) is still approved and unpaid, as you asked given the dispute. INV-20002 was already paid, and INV-78192 is still a draft.
